XMLDB.COMMENT: Airpay WhatsApp + SMS engagement channel — opt-in preferences (iter 1), DLT registry (iter 2), send log (iter 3+).

TABLE.NAME: local_airpay_user_channel_prefs
TABLE.COMMENT: Per-user opt-in preferences for WhatsApp / SMS / email channels. One row per user. Phase A1 iter 1.

FIELD.NAME: id
FIELD.COMMENT: Primary key

FIELD.NAME: userid
FIELD.COMMENT: FK to mdl_user.id — one row per user (unique)

FIELD.NAME: mobile_number
FIELD.COMMENT: Mobile number with country code, e.g. +919876543210

FIELD.NAME: whatsapp_optin
FIELD.COMMENT: 0=opted out, 1=opted in to WhatsApp delivery

FIELD.NAME: sms_optin
FIELD.COMMENT: 0=opted out, 1=opted in to SMS delivery

FIELD.NAME: email_optin
FIELD.COMMENT: Always-on by default. Users can suppress per the existing email cadence engine.

FIELD.NAME: prefer_channel
FIELD.COMMENT: Primary delivery channel: 'whatsapp' | 'sms' | 'email'. Falls back to email when delivery fails.

FIELD.NAME: dlt_consent_at
FIELD.COMMENT: Unix timestamp when DLT consent was given. Required before WhatsApp/SMS can deliver.

FIELD.NAME: dlt_consent_text
FIELD.COMMENT: Snapshot of the consent language the user agreed to. Stored for audit / DPDP compliance.

TABLE.NAME: local_airpay_user_channel_audit
TABLE.COMMENT: Append-only audit trail of every preference change. DPDP requires demonstrable consent provenance.

FIELD.NAME: userid
FIELD.COMMENT: The user whose preferences changed

FIELD.NAME: changed_by
FIELD.COMMENT: Who made the change — usually the same as userid, but admins can edit on behalf of

FIELD.NAME: field_name
FIELD.COMMENT: Which field changed: 'whatsapp_optin' | 'sms_optin' | 'mobile_number' | 'prefer_channel' | 'dlt_consent_at'

FIELD.NAME: reason
FIELD.COMMENT: Optional context (e.g. 'self-service via /preferences.php', 'admin override')

FIELD.NAME: ip_address
FIELD.COMMENT: IPv4/IPv6 of the request that made the change — required by DPDP for consent provenance

INDEX.NAME: idx_user_time
INDEX.COMMENT: Audit history per user, newest first

INDEX.NAME: idx_field_time
INDEX.COMMENT: Bulk audit queries (e.g. all dlt_consent_at changes in date range)

TABLE.NAME: local_airpay_dlt_templates
TABLE.COMMENT: DLT-approved message template registry (iter 2). Templates must be DLT-registered with the operator before WhatsApp/SMS sending is allowed. The cadence engine refuses to send any template not in `approved` state.

FIELD.NAME: template_key
FIELD.COMMENT: Stable internal identifier (e.g. 'course_enrolment', 'deadline_3d'). Used by the cadence engine.

FIELD.NAME: channel
FIELD.COMMENT: 'whatsapp' | 'sms' — same template_key can have separate variants per channel

FIELD.NAME: category
FIELD.COMMENT: DLT category: 'transactional' (no consent needed for service messages) or 'promotional' (consent required)

FIELD.NAME: dlt_id
FIELD.COMMENT: The Template ID assigned by the DLT portal once approved

FIELD.NAME: status
FIELD.COMMENT: 'pending' | 'submitted' | 'approved' | 'rejected' — only 'approved' templates can send

FIELD.NAME: body
FIELD.COMMENT: The template body with {{variable}} placeholders. Stored as the canonical version we sent to DLT.

FIELD.NAME: variables_json
FIELD.COMMENT: JSON array of variable names extracted from {{...}} placeholders in the body

FIELD.NAME: language
FIELD.COMMENT: Template language code (en, hi, kn, mr, sw)

FIELD.NAME: rejection_reason
FIELD.COMMENT: If status=rejected, the DLT operator's reason — surfaced to admin for resubmission

FIELD.NAME: last_synced_at
FIELD.COMMENT: Last time the nightly cron checked this template's status with the DLT portal

KEY.NAME: uk_key_channel_lang
KEY.COMMENT: One template per (key, channel, language) triple

TABLE.NAME: local_airpay_send_log
TABLE.COMMENT: Per-attempt log of every WhatsApp/SMS/email send (iter 3+). Used for retry, analytics, and bounce-to-email fallback.

FIELD.NAME: channel
FIELD.COMMENT: 'whatsapp' | 'sms' | 'email'

FIELD.NAME: template_key
FIELD.COMMENT: FK to local_airpay_dlt_templates.template_key (logical FK, not enforced — email has its own template namespace)

FIELD.NAME: status
FIELD.COMMENT: 'queued' | 'sent' | 'delivered' | 'failed' | 'bounced' | 'opted_out' | 'mocked'

FIELD.NAME: provider_id
FIELD.COMMENT: External message ID from the provider — used to correlate webhook delivery receipts

FIELD.NAME: recipient
FIELD.COMMENT: Mobile number (WhatsApp/SMS) or email address (email channel). Stored for audit.

FIELD.NAME: attempts
FIELD.COMMENT: Retry count — most failures get 3 attempts before falling back to email

FIELD.NAME: cost_paise
FIELD.COMMENT: Provider-reported cost in paise (1/100 of INR). NULL for mock/email.

FIELD.NAME: mock_mode
FIELD.COMMENT: 0=real send, 1=mock (logged but not actually sent). Mock is the default until [CONFIRM] flips production.

FIELD.NAME: timeupdated
FIELD.COMMENT: Last status transition (set on delivery webhook etc.)

INDEX.NAME: idx_status_time
INDEX.COMMENT: Bulk filters: WHERE status='queued' for retry cron
